title: Implement offline TS shard and index preparation
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
scripts/worldwide/build-index.ts, data/worldwide/index-format.schema.json, and tests/worldwide/index-format.test.ts are untracked working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status. Its own sha256 is not stored inside this file.
The builder does not read parquet and does not call Python. It measures a JSON projection of country IR routing rows. A local filesystem path is not written into the public index.

A release is reused only when schema, layout family, tokenizer, BM25 constants, a finite average document length, checksums, measured shard bytes, inclusive non-overlapping term ranges, and document shards are compatible. Corpus paths stay in excluded_corpus_paths and are omitted from remote_shard_bytes. Inline corpus text is not copied. Supplied documents are ignored on the reuse path.

An incompatible release with document records emits compact postings under the caller identity. An incompatible release without documents throws country-ir-incompatible. No inputs throws no-index-input.
The Pages document is the routing manifest only. full_corpus_bundled and index_payload_bundled stay false. Offline postings, document bodies, and embeddings are not bundled on Pages.
routeTerm returns null when no inclusive range matches. It does not fall back to every shard.
Index tokenization always uses the pinned fts5-unicode61 tokenizer. A document language does not select another strategy.
Official citations are not invented. Identifiers over the schema maximum are dropped. A stored title may be truncated to 256 characters. The body is checksummed and is not stored.
Reuse requires measured document shards and keyword ranges. An empty keyword_shards array does not fall through to indexes.bm25_keyword_shards.
utf8Size uses the utf8Bytes encoder from identity.ts. Jest's jsdom environment does not define the global TextEncoder.
